Resolves #3623

Adds `container.Viewport` inference to `guessBaseClass()` in `buildScripts/create/class.mjs` when `className.toLowerCase().endsWith('viewport')`, and exports `guessBaseClass` behind `isEntryModule(import.meta.url)` so it can be unit-tested directly without triggering interactive CLI prompts.

Evidence: L2 (Playwright unit spec `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/createClass.spec.mjs` executes in CI) → L2 required (unit verification of `guessBaseClass` return values across `Viewport` and existing base-class suffixes).

Micro-review eligible: mechanical-2-file — adds `endsWith('viewport') => 'container.Viewport'` to `guessBaseClass()` and exports it behind `isEntryModule(import.meta.url)` with a unit spec.
